Based on the image provided, here is the description of what is visible:

**Are animatronic characters visible under colored spotlights?**
**No.** The main camera feed (labeled "CAM 01 - ESCENARIO") is currently displaying a **completely black screen**. There are no animatronic characters, spotlights, or stage details visible within this specific camera view.

**Is the image dark but VISIBLE?**
**No.** The central portion of the image representing the security feed is **pure black** (or effectively void of visual data). It is not a "dark" image where shapes can be discerned; it is an empty/black feed.

**Description of what is seen:**
The image displays a user interface resembling a security system from a video game (specifically *Five Nights at Freddy's*).
*   **Central Feed:** A large black rectangle dominates the center, indicating that Camera 01 (Stage) is either off, disabled, or showing nothing.
*   **UI Elements:**
    *   **Top Left:** Text reads "CAM 01 - ESCENARIO REC • 1987-10-12".
    *   **Bottom Right:** A map layout of the building is visible, along with a grid of buttons numbered 01 through 12 for selecting different cameras. Camera **01** is highlighted in green.
    *   **Bottom Left:** Control text instructions in Spanish (e.g., "[C] CERRAR", "CAMBIAR CAMARA").
*   **Periphery:** On the far right edge of the screen, partially cut off, there appears to be a small part of a character (likely the animatronic **Chica**, based on the yellow coloring and shape), but this is outside the camera monitor interface itself.

**Summary:** You are looking at a blank, black security camera feed for the Stage (Camera 01). No characters or lights are visible on the monitor.
